sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully targets web frames, constrains the table-based alpha values and fixed f13 factor, uses compatible canonical properties and units, and validates the unit-adjusted shear-area formula with bounded numeric tolerance.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Prevent accidental passes from multi-valued quantity nodes: add sh:maxCount 1 to every top-level operand/result property and to each nested qudt:numericValue and qudt:unit property. As written, a QuantityValue can carry the required unit alongside an incompatible extra unit, while the SPARQL ignores unit multiplicity, so invalid evidence can pass.

Remove the table/fixed-coefficient alternatives from SPARQL: constrain f13's qudt:numericValue to 1.1 with SHACL Core and encode the 11 Af/Aw-to-alpha pairs as Core sh:or branches. Retain one bounded SPARQL constraint only for the tolerance-based requiredShearArea formula using the validated operands and existing units.

The candidate faithfully targets web frames, constrains the table-based alpha values and fixed f13 factor, uses compatible canonical properties and units, and validates the unit-adjusted shear-area formula with bounded numeric tolerance.
